lines.text: Can't stop the bomb from going off! Ha-ha!
Mega Man, come on! You, me, two blue guys!
If we can just get that gate open!
We have to find the key!
You mean this key? I found it. In the tower.
Alright, maybe we have a chance after all. Hold on to that key!
